title: Wound Planimetry
description: Calibrated wound and ulcer digital planimetry with color-based Red-Yellow-Black (RYB) tissue estimation in CIE L*a*b* and HSV colour space.

measure.title: Measure wound
measure.description: Segment the wound bed, compute calibrated or pixel planimetry geometry, and estimate Red (granulation), Yellow (slough/fibrin), Black (eschar/necrosis), and Unclassified color-based RYB tissue fractions.

image.description: One clinical wound photograph (JPEG or PNG).

pixelsPerMm.description: Spatial calibration in pixels per millimetre; 0 reports pixel units.

sensitivity.description: Threshold bias subtracted from Otsu wound-bed segmentation (threshold = otsu - sensitivity; negative values tighten, positive values expand the mask).

escharL.description: CIE L* lightness upper bound for black necrotic eschar tissue.

granulationA.description: CIE a* redness lower bound for red granulation tissue.

sloughB.description: CIE b* yellowness lower bound for yellow slough and fibrin tissue.
